model.title: Monterey Bay National Heritage Area Study Act
model.meta: Energy and Natural Resources Committee · Sen. Alex Padilla (D-CA)

summary.text: The bill would direct the Secretary of the Interior to study whether certain lands around Monterey Bay in California should be officially designated as a National Heritage Area, which would recognize the region's cultural, historical, and natural significance and potentially help coordinate conservation and tourism efforts in the area.
